learning_outcomes.text: To develop the individual's communication skills with themselves and their environment.
To gain skills in developing understanding and solutions for communication problems within the institution they work for.
To provide skills in learning effective listening.

syllabus_topics: Communication Forms, Functions and Communication Models
Communication in Organizations and Organizational Communication Forms
Barriers in Organizational Communication and Development of Communication
Communication Forms in Businesses According to Management Approaches
Non-verbal Communication, Effective Listening and Professional Image
The Role of Cultural Differences in Communication
bibliography: Hasan Tutar, Örgütsel İletişim, Seçkin Yayıncılık, 2003.
Üstün Dökmen, İletişim Çatışmaları ve Empati, Remzi Kitabevi, 2008.
